
The code below allows to save the file to drive and already get a public url
```{r}
library(googledrive)

drive_auth()

folder <- drive_get("llm_dump")

file <- drive_upload(
  media = "data/cv_main.xlsx",
  path = folder,
  name = "dead_test2_public.xlsx"
)

# Make it public (anyone with link can view)
drive_share(file, role = "reader", type = "anyone")

# Get link
file <- drive_get(as_id(file$id))  # refresh metadata

link <- file$drive_resource[[1]]$webViewLink

link
```
